'''347.609/D5''' was an [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Commander/Legends|commander]]. This commander was in charge of a small group of veteran soldiers, consisting of [[Explorer Squad Esk-23]], [[Stormtrooper Squad Aurek]] and [[Stormtrooper Squad Besh|Besh]], who had been abandoned on [[Endor/Legends|Endor]] after the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]]. 347-609/D5 was under orders to link up any remaining Imperial forces on Endor and lead them to [[Assault HQ]], harrying and eliminating any [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel]] and Ewok opposition on the way. When their scouts happened upon an [[Unidentified Ewok village (Sector 5-7)|Ewok village]] in [[Sector 5-7]], they ordered their men to [[Skirmish on Endor (Recon-A)|attack]].
